hero.oneLiner: The deck positions IREDA as "India's Largest Pure-play Green Financing NBFC" and the Ministry of New & Renewable Energy's dedicated financing entity - a 71.76% Government-owned Navratna CPSE with RBI Infrastructure Finance Company status, AAA (Stable) domestic ratings and a ~Rs 94,936 crore renewable-energy loan book.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Describes itself as "India's Largest Pure-play Green Financing NBFC" with "Over 39 years of experience" and a comprehensive suite of financial products and services for the RE sector; also the "Ministry of New & Renewable Energy's Dedicated Financing Entity" and implementation/nodal agency for several prominent MNRE schemes.
- Regulatory standing: Infrastructure Finance Company (IFC) status from RBI (granted 2025 per the milestones timeline) and classified as a Middle Layer Non-Deposit Taking NBFC; 71.76% owned by the Government of India and awarded Navratna status by DPE.
- Credit standing: "AAA (Stable) domestic credit rating from ICRA, CARE, India Ratings, Brickwork, Acuite, etc." and "BBB (Stable) international rating by S&P Global"; the borrowing-profile slide separately shows an 'A-2' short-term and 'BBB' long-term Stable international rating.
- Rated 'Excellent' as per MoU with MNRE for FY21, 22, 23, 24 & 25; milestones cite Gold in Corporate Governance & CSR at PSE Awards 2024, the Data Centre Excellence Award 2026 and Silver at the Green Urja Awards.
- Sector backdrop as stated by the deck: MNRE target of 500 GW non-fossil-fuel-based energy by 2030, with India having "attained remarkable non-fossil fuel capacity till 30.06.2026" of 297 GW.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- "Initiated Dividend Distribution Post Listing" is listed among the corporate-governance commitments.
- Equity has been raised in steps: GOI equity infusion of Rs 1,500 crores (2018 milestone), IPO debut (2023 milestone), and Rs 2,006 crores raised through a Qualified Institutional Placement (2026 milestone).
- Hybrid capital used as well: first-ever issue of Perpetual Debt Instruments (PDI) of Rs 1,247 crores (2024 milestone) and an earlier Green Masala Bond (2018).
- Capital position as on 30.06.26: net worth Rs 14,133 crores, CRAR 20.30% and Debt Equity Ratio 5.59 (against 5.65 as on 31.03.26 and 5.35 as on 30.06.25).

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Asset quality] Gross NPA of Rs 3,568 cr / 3.76% and Net NPA of Rs 1,134 cr / 1.23% as on 30.06.26; Provision Coverage Ratio improved to 68.22% from 51.10% a year earlier, with provision for impairment of Rs 2,434 cr against gross NPAs.
- [Litigation-driven slippage] The NPA charts carry a footnote: "Relates to FY 2019-20 for one borrower shifted from stage II to NPA due to AP High Court Order dated 02.07.2025", with starred amounts 671*, 145*, 783* and 314* shown on the series.
- [Ownership] President of India (GOI) holding is unchanged at 71.76% across 30.06.25, 31.03.26 and 30.06.26; resident individuals hold 21.98% and FIIs & FPIs 2.48% as on 30.06.2026, with LIC the largest non-GOI single holder at 2.21%.
- [Entity scope] Consolidated numbers are only marginally above standalone (e.g. consolidated revenue from operations Rs 8,310 cr for the year ended 31-03-2026 against Rs 8,309 cr standalone), indicating subsidiaries are currently immaterial to the group P&L.
